fullText.simplified:
一、饭饭是一只猫

    饭饭是一只猫，今年三岁，他住在一个咖啡店的旁边。饭饭以前不住在这儿，他有家，他和人妈妈住在一起。人妈妈对他很好，那是他最快乐的时候。但是有一天，饭饭找不到人妈妈了。那天，人妈妈在商店里买东西，饭饭和一只猫在外面玩儿。他们玩儿了很长时间，跑了很远。饭饭不认识回去的路了，他找不到人妈妈，也找不到家了。
    他一个人住在咖啡店的旁边，有时候会有人给他一点儿吃的。几个月后，他认识了一个朋友。这个朋友是只小黄猫，没有名字，也没有家。饭饭每天和小黄猫一起玩儿，一起找吃的。学校后面，商店前面，饭店旁边，他们都去过。他们一起吃过苹果，一起喝过牛奶，他们是最好的朋友。
    小黄猫不知道家是什么。饭饭真想找到人妈妈，他想请小黄猫去他家，他想让人妈妈见见小黄猫。小黄猫这么漂亮，人妈妈会喜欢她的。饭饭想，到那时候，小黄猫就会知道什么是家了吧！
fullText.traditional:
一、飯飯是一隻貓

    飯飯是一隻貓，今年三歲，他住在一個咖啡店的旁邊。飯飯以前不住在這兒，他有家，他和人媽媽住在一起。人媽媽對他很好，那是他最快樂的時候。但是有一天，飯飯找不到人媽媽了。那天，人媽媽在商店裡買東西，飯飯和一隻貓在外面玩兒。他們玩兒了很長時間，跑了很遠。飯飯不認識回去的路了，他找不到人媽媽，也找不到家了。
    他一個人住在咖啡店的旁邊，有時候會有人給他一點兒吃的。幾個月後，他認識了一個朋友。這個朋友是隻小黃貓，沒有名字，也沒有家。飯飯每天和小黃貓一起玩兒，一起找吃的。學校後面，商店前面，飯店旁邊，他們都去過。他們一起吃過蘋果，一起喝過牛奶，他們是最好的朋友。
    小黃貓不知道家是什麼。飯飯真想找到人媽媽，他想請小黃貓去他家，他想讓人媽媽見見小黃貓。小黃貓這麼漂亮，人媽媽會喜歡她的。飯飯想，到那時候，小黃貓就會知道什麼是家了吧！

sentences.simplified: 饭饭是一只猫，今年三岁，他住在一个咖啡店的旁边。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯是一隻貓，今年三歲，他住在一個咖啡店的旁邊。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn shì yì zhī māo jīn nián sān suì tā zhù zài yí ge kā fēi diàn de páng biān
sentences.english: Fanfan is a cat. He is three years old this year. He lives next to a coffee shop.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭以前不住在这儿，他有家，他和人妈妈住在一起。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯以前不住在這兒，他有家，他和人媽媽住在一起。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn yǐ qián bú zhù zài zhè‘r tā yǒu jiā tā hé rén mā ma zhù zài yì qǐ
sentences.english: Fanfan didn’t live here before. He had a home. He lived with his human mom.

sentences.simplified: 人妈妈对他很好，那是他最快乐的时候。但是有一天，饭饭找不到人妈妈了。
sentences.traditional: 人媽媽對他很好，那是他最快樂的時候。但是有一天，飯飯找不到人媽媽了。
sentences.pinyin: rén mā ma duì tā hěn hǎo nà shì tā zuì kuài lè de shí hou dàn shì yǒu yì tiān fàn fàn zhǎo bú dào rén mā ma le
sentences.english: His human mom was very good to him. That was his happiest time. But one day, Fanfan couldn’t find his human mom.

sentences.simplified: 那天，人妈妈在商店里买东西，饭饭和一只猫在外面玩儿。
sentences.traditional: 那天，人媽媽在商店裡買東西，飯飯和一隻貓在外面玩兒。
sentences.pinyin: nà tiān rén mā ma zài shāng diàn lǐ mǎi dōng xi fàn fàn hé yì zhī māo zài wài miàn wán'r
sentences.english: That day, Fanfan’s human mom was shopping in a store, and Fanfan was playing outside with a cat.

sentences.simplified: 他们玩儿了很长时间，跑了很远。
sentences.traditional: 他們玩兒了很長時間，跑了很遠。
sentences.pinyin: tā men wán'r le hěn cháng shí jiān pǎo le hěn yuǎn
sentences.english: They played for a very long time and ran very far.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭不认识回去的路了，他找不到人妈妈，也找不到家了。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯不認識回去的路了，他找不到人媽媽，也找不到家了。
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn bú rèn shi huí qù de lù le tā zhǎo bú dào rén mā ma yě zhǎo bú dào jiā le
sentences.english: Fanfan didn’t know the way back. He couldn’t find his human mom, and he couldn’t find his home.

sentences.simplified: 他一个人住在咖啡店的旁边，有时候会有人给他一点儿吃的。
sentences.traditional: 他一個人住在咖啡店的旁邊，有時候會有人給他一點兒吃的。
sentences.pinyin: tā yí ge rén zhù zài kā fēi diàn de páng biān yǒu shí hou huì yǒu rén gěi tā yì diǎn'r chī de
sentences.english: He lived alone next to the coffee shop. Sometimes, people would give him a little food.

sentences.simplified: 几个月后，他认识了一个朋友。这个朋友是只小黄猫，没有名字，也没有家。
sentences.traditional: 幾個月後，他認識了一個朋友。這個朋友是隻小黃貓，沒有名字，也沒有家。
sentences.pinyin: jǐ ge yuè hòu tā rèn shi le yí ge péng you zhè ge péng you shì zhī xiǎo huáng māo méi yǒu míng zi yě méi yǒu jiā
sentences.english: A few months later, he made a friend. This friend is a little yellow cat, with no name and no home.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭每天和小黄猫一起玩儿，一起找吃的。
sentences.traditional: 飯飯每天和小黃貓一起玩兒，一起找吃的。

sentences.english: Fanfan plays with the little yellow cat every day, and they look for food together.

sentences.simplified: 学校后面，商店前面，饭店旁边，他们都去过。
sentences.traditional: 學校後面，商店前面，飯店旁邊，他們都去過。
sentences.pinyin: xué xiào hòu miàn shāng diàn qián miàn fàn diàn páng biān tā men dōu qù guò
sentences.english: They have been behind the school, in front of the store, and next to the restaurant.

sentences.simplified: 他们一起吃过苹果，一起喝过牛奶，他们是最好的朋友。
sentences.traditional: 他們一起吃過蘋果，一起喝過牛奶，他們是最好的朋友。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yì qǐ chī guò píng guǒ yì qǐ hē guò niú nǎi tā men shì zuì hǎo de péng you
sentences.english: They have eaten apples together and drunk milk together, and they are the best of friends.

sentences.simplified: 小黄猫不知道家是什么。饭饭真想找到人妈妈，
sentences.traditional: 小黃貓不知道家是什麼。飯飯真想找到人媽媽，
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo huáng māo bù zhī dào jiā shì shén me fàn fàn zhēn xiǎng zhǎo dào rén mā ma
sentences.english: The little yellow cat doesn’t know what home is. Fanfan really wants to find his human mom.

sentences.simplified: 他想请小黄猫去他家，他想让人妈妈见见小黄猫。
sentences.traditional: 他想請小黃貓去他家，他想讓人媽媽見見小黃貓。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng qǐng xiǎo huáng māo qù tā jiā tā xiǎng ràng rén mā ma jiàn jiàn xiǎo huáng māo
sentences.english: He wants to invite the little yellow cat to his home. He wants his human mom to meet the little yellow cat.

sentences.simplified: 小黄猫这么漂亮，人妈妈会喜欢她的。
sentences.traditional: 小黃貓這麼漂亮，人媽媽會喜歡她的。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo huáng māo zhè me piào liang rén mā ma huì xǐ huan tā de
sentences.english: The little yellow cat is so beautiful. His human mom will like her.

sentences.simplified: 饭饭想，到那时候，小黄猫就会知道什么是家了吧！
sentences.traditional: 飯飯想，到那時候，小黃貓就會知道什麼是家了吧！
sentences.pinyin: fàn fàn xiǎng dào nà shí hou xiǎo huáng māo jiù huì zhī dào shén me shì jiā le ba
sentences.english: Fanfan thought that by then, the little yellow cat would know what a home is!

sentence_translations: Fanfan is a cat. He is three years old this year. He lives next to a coffee shop.
Fanfan didn’t live here before. He had a home. He lived with his human mom.
His human mom was very good to him. That was his happiest time. But one day, Fanfan couldn’t find his human mom.
That day, Fanfan’s human mom was shopping in a store, and Fanfan was playing outside with a cat.
They played for a very long time and ran very far.
Fanfan didn’t know the way back. He couldn’t find his human mom, and he couldn’t find his home.
He lived alone next to the coffee shop. Sometimes, people would give him a little food.
A few months later, he made a friend. This friend is a little yellow cat, with no name and no home.
Fanfan plays with the little yellow cat every day, and they look for food together.
They have been behind the school, in front of the store, and next to the restaurant.
They have eaten apples together and drunk milk together, and they are the best of friends.
The little yellow cat doesn’t know what home is. Fanfan really wants to find his human mom.
He wants to invite the little yellow cat to his home. He wants his human mom to meet the little yellow cat.
The little yellow cat is so beautiful. His human mom will like her.
Fanfan thought that by then, the little yellow cat would know what a home is!
